form.officialName: Order to Seal Arrest and Related Records

strategy.rationale: XFA source with a widget shadow. Proposed order: the petitioner completes only the item-1 identity block the form assigns to them; the caption stamp blocks are the clerk’s, and every finding, the sealing directive and the judicial signature are the court’s.

legalIntegrityDisposition: The participant is identified exactly where the official form asks for it and nowhere else. Clerk-labelled blocks stay blank because the form says the clerk completes them; findings, the sealing directive and the judicial signature stay blank because they are the court’s.

printedInstruction: Clerk fills in the name and street address of the court.
Clerk fills in the number and name of the case.
Clerk stamps date here when form is filed.
clerkOnlyFields.finding: F2-15. These three widgets sit directly beneath the form’s own clerk instructions and were previously bound, while the petitioner’s item-1 identity block was classified protected and rendered blank. The fill was inverted: the order shipped with the petitioner unidentified and the clerk’s blocks pre-completed.

en.formPurpose: CR-410 is the order the judge signs if your petition to seal is granted. You file it with CR-409 showing only your name and mailing address.
en.whatYouDo: Fill in nothing else. The clerk completes the court and case blocks; the judge decides and signs.
en.whatWeDoNotDo: LegalEase never completes a clerk block, never marks a finding, and never fills the judge’s signature or date.
en.noCheckout: This form is not available for purchase. It is prepared for review only.

es.formPurpose: El CR-410 es la orden que el juez firma si se concede su peticion de sellar. Se presenta con el CR-409 mostrando solo su nombre y direccion postal.
es.whatYouDo: No complete nada mas. El secretario llena los bloques del tribunal y del caso; el juez decide y firma.
es.whatWeDoNotDo: LegalEase nunca completa un bloque del secretario, nunca marca una determinacion, y nunca llena la firma o la fecha del juez.
es.noCheckout: Este formulario no esta disponible para la compra. Se prepara unicamente para revision.

mustNotContain: Superior Court of California, County of Los Angeles
